publisherId.description: Structured slug identifying who maintains/distributes this item. Effective id is publisherId.type.id. Independent of the freeform author credit.

version.description: Semver content version of this item build.

minAppVersion.description: Optional semver floor of the Spiral app that can load this item.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor validation.

id.description: Declared item id. Effective id is publisherId.type.id.

name.description: Human-readable display label. May be empty on drafts.

author.description: Freeform credit for the contribution's creator. Independent of pack.json publisherId (pack maintainer/distributor).

description.description: Short summary for lists/cards; keep longer notes in the pack README.

tokens.description: CSS custom property tokens. Required keys (color-bg, color-text-primary, color-accent, color-danger, font-ui) are enforced on install, export and apply; drafts may omit keys while saving. font-ui is a font id from the app's font catalog, not a CSS stack. Surface, border and muted colors are derived from these.
